topups.title: ADD EXTRA HOURS TO YOUR PLAN
topups.description: Choose how many video hours to add to your plan and see the estimated cost.

includedTime.q: How much video time does each plan include?
includedTime.a: Each month, Free includes 30 minutes; Basic, 5 hours; Standard, 10 hours; and Premium, 20 hours.

extraHours.a: Paid plans can add 1 to 100 hours. Each hour costs S/5; the calculator also shows a rounded US$1.50 estimate.

annualBilling.a: Annual subscriptions are paid upfront. Plan cards show the monthly equivalent; in soles, annual billing is 20% less than 12 monthly payments. US dollar amounts are rounded.

cancel.a: Yes. You can cancel your plan anytime and keep access until the end of your paid period.

currencies.q: Which currencies can I view prices in?
currencies.a: The landing shows prices in soles and rounded US dollar estimates. The app’s current Mercado Pago checkout processes payments in soles.
